subject: E-4281: upload stalls on macOS
body:
Hello support team. We run PixelForge 6.0.8 on macOS 14.7. Since Tuesday, every time I upload a
file, I get 'E-4281: upload stalled at 0 bytes/s'.

A sync was interrupted by a power cut halfway through last week. Ever since, it stops at the same
file every time.

Before writing in I tried rebooting the router; same error afterwards.

Regards, Daniel Ortega, Tessa Labs
